core.title: Renegade Stainless Steel Door Lever, AHI SIG153

text.description_html:
AHI SIG153, Renegade Stainless Steel Leverset

With the machined holes along the grip portion, some would say the Renegade Stainless Steel Door Lever resembles the cooling cage around a WWII Aircraft .50 caliber; and the mechanized feel only adds to the weaponry appeal. Easy to install, the Renegade Stainless Steel Leverset will fit standard door preparations. The concealed mounting screws insure that the sophisticated design is left unmarred. Made out of stainless steel, the AHI SIG153 is available in passage, privacy, and dummy functions. Stainless steel is extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasions. Since it does not degrade in appearance or function even after many years of hard use, this leverset can be used in any commercial or residential setting where durability and style are desired. The Renegade Stainless Steel Leverset is ADA compliant. This lever and rose set can be adjusted for 1-3/8 inch to 2 inch thick doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets.

Features of the AHI SIG153 Renegade Stainless Steel Door Lever:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • For residential or commercial applications
  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors)
  • Field reversible tubular latch
  • Premium latch requires only 28° rotation to retract latchbolt
  • Meets standards of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Specifications of the SIG153 Renegade Stainless Steel Leverset:

  • Lever Length: 5.20" (132 mm)
  • Lever Width: 0.71" (18 mm)
  • Lever Projection: 2.20" (56 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 0.31" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2.52" (64 mm)
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of door. Lever is surface mounted (mounting plate screws to the doors face).
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. For use with a standard 2-1/8" bore hole pre-drilled door.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
